mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, p.status AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_answer a WHERE a.project_id = p.id AND a.temp_save = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0) AS answerCount, (SELECT AVG(a.exam_score) FROM t_answer a WHERE a.project_id = p.id AND a.temp_save = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0) AS avgScore FROM t_project p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND (p.create_by = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_project_partner pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.id AND pp.user_id = #{userId} AND pp.type IN (1,2))) ORDER BY p.create_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(d.id, '') AS deptId, COALESCE(d.name, '未分组') AS deptName, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, AVG(a.exam_score) AS avgScore FROM t_answer a JOIN t_user u ON u.id = a.create_by LEFT JOIN t_dept d ON d.id = COALESCE(a.class_id, u.dept_id) AND d.dept_type = 'class' AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.temp_save = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(a.class_id, u.dept_id), d.id, d.name ORDER BY answerCount DESC
